claims.text: Large language model applications have expanded from natural language processing into computer vision and scientific computing.
The rapid surge in large language model research creates significant challenges for researchers to comprehensively grasp field dynamics and key technologies.

evidence.description: The authors state that applications have continuously expanded from natural language processing to computer vision, scientific computing, and other vertical industry fields.
The paper notes that the rapid surge in research work in a short period poses significant challenges for researchers to comprehensively grasp research dynamics and understand key technologies.

methodologies.name: Comprehensive Literature Survey
methodologies.description: Systematic review and analysis of large language model architectures, optimization methods, interdisciplinary technology integrations, deployment strategies, and industry applications.

limitations.text: The rapid volume growth of research work makes comprehensive coverage and synthesis challenging for researchers.
Existing large language models face inherent technological limitations and operational challenges during real-world deployment.

future_work.text: Secondary development and industry application of large language models through integration with interdisciplinary technologies such as contrastive learning, retrieval enhancement, hallucination dissolution, and multimodal architectures.
